XenotypeDef.label: khorsy
XenotypeDef.description: The Khorsy line is the only surviving one of many created for a world of collectors and players. They haven't endured to this day because they were the best; they were simply the most consistent, or perhaps a hybrid with characteristics common to many of those lines.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: They are neither the fastest nor the most unstoppable nor the most powerful, but they are quite useful.

XenotypeDef.label: nudis
XenotypeDef.description: The project's name was Nudibranchia electricus. In a twist of events, it was originally about animals; the diversion to human modification was an act of corruption and illegality. In another plot twist, the staff were killed, the creations took control of the laboratory, and continued the project.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: They were found in the swamp of a remote planet. When their technology broke down, they regressed to a tribal and nudist state. Their discoverers were pirates who didn't realize in time the bad idea of ​​trying to dominate them. At the bottom of the swamp lay hundreds of varieties of aggressive Nudis.
